overview_description.description: Welnes is an app that connects users with nutritionists and trainers with personalized meal and workout plans. The company assists users in achieving their goals, whether they are to build muscle, lose weight, or simply live a healthier lifestyle. Welnes establishes a community for dieticians and nutritionists and for those looking to live a healthy lifestyle, eat healthy food, and alter their physical appearance.
